summary: This clinical trial is testing the drug efsubaglutide alfa and diet and exercise guidelines for adults who are still obese six months after weight-loss surgery. The study looks at changes in body weight over a 24-week period. The trial is currently Recruiting 60 participants. The sponsor of this study is The Affiliated Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital of Nanjing University Medical School.
